acceptance_note: P8-P12 are not claimed complete where required data or infrastructure is unavailable.

P0.evidence: 5,000-tick clean run, prior reproducibility and concurrency evidence; Docker digest unavailable.

P10.evidence: Jacobian diagnostic exists, but the 13-versus-15 measurement contract is unresolved and traffic is unchanged.

P11.evidence: Second feeder and authorized cross-condition/cross-topology held-out evaluation are unavailable.

P12.evidence: Elevated Windows packet capture infrastructure is unavailable; no simulated substitute was used.

P2.evidence: Static provenance, blind re-extraction and canary evidence are present; fresh historical pre-PR16 checkout is unavailable.

P3.evidence: All configured train/validation/OOD/clean seed outputs exist at the recorded tick count.

P6.evidence: All prescribed arms and available model families executed on train/validation only; no held-out evaluation.

P7.evidence: Pilot final comparison exists, but independent exposure and statistical power are insufficient for production claims.

P8.evidence: Required 24-hour real-clock clean validation and independent clean held-out exposure are not available.

P9.evidence: Required magnitude/profile grid and benign/natural-fault corpus are not available.
